text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, as I'm treating Nakayama
Festa to
a tasty taiyaki treat...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! Spin the wheel and try
your luck! Do
we have any takers?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, a raffle.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a shot?
Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do. Have you forgotten who I
am?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we grab some drinks and stuff
from the
shopping district to claim a
raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I won't let this go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa gives the raffle wheel a
mighty
spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic job! Here's your hot spring
coupon!
Enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Okay. Wanna head back?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm still excited. This doesn't look like
your
ordinary hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Here, you take it. Call it a thanks for
letting me
spin the raffle wheel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa shows almost zero
interest in the
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The coupon earns us a free trip to a
famous
getaway spot for top
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Then I'll decide whether to use it based on your results.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Like a reward?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we get the chance to race overseas, it
could
benefit her to relax and rest up
before
completing our final
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, if she can't deliver the results
we need,
we'll have to refocus our
efforts. In that case,
we'll forget about
the hot springs idea.
choice_data_list: So whether you can actually put this to use is up to you.
So whether you can actually put this to use is up to you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So if our preparations don't go
well, the
hot springs getaway is off the
table, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A suggestion with both risk and reward—now that's what I call a gamble!
choice_data_list: That should help fuel your fire a bit, right?
That should help fuel your fire a bit, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Too right. Heh. You know me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nakayama Festa and I have
placed a new
wager.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, first-prize! Not too shabby.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, just one, though? We can't split the
spoils
then.
choice_data_list: Since it's here, why don't you eat it?
Since we have it, why don't you eat it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No... that wouldn't be right. Let me think
this over
again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There are two people and only one
reward. So,
what do we do?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Okay, flip them!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Straight flush! What have you got?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right. That makes both the carrot
hamburger
steak and cup noodles from
your house all mine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, Nakayama Festa takes
the
carrot hamburger and cleans out my
kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Not a bad haul! They'll taste nice after a
stint on
the grill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Consider it a thanks for the taiyaki and
letting me
spin the raffle wheel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Man
text_block_list.text:
If it isn't, Nakayama! Eat up! It's my treat
today!

text_block_list.name: Oden Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
That won't be necessary! Come over
here,
Nakayama. I got a bowl of carrot
stew with your
name on it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Pops. Come on, Trainer. There's
some for
you too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The broth here's the best in Japan. So,
eat up.

text_block_list.name: Oden Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
This one's on the house. A little thanks
for all
those carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We get the bushel of carrots turned into
some
delicious food at one of Nakayama
Festa's go-to
restaurants. The taste
leaves a warm feeling
inside.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I expected as much. It's usually the
low-tier
green or blue balls that'll come
out, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Meh. Same difference—you know what I
mean.
Haven't you played games at the
arcade before?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa begins flipping the
prize carrot
between her fingers. Just
like that, we set off
back to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Aahh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't feel too bad. It's pretty
normal. I get
duds like ninety-percent of
the time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah. So no point in fretting over it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa tries her best to
console me, but
then accidentally lets
out a sigh.
